description: This file defines the VoiceSessionCoordinator class, which manages voice recognition sessions within the application. It handles starting, updating, finalizing, and dismissing speech recognition sessions, coordinating with overlay UI components and forwarding transcripts for processing.

classes.name: VoiceSessionCoordinator
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for managing voice recognition sessions, including starting, updating, finalizing, and dismissing sessions, and coordinating the UI overlay and forwarding transcripts.

classes.name: VoiceSessionCoordinator.Source
classes.description: An enum representing the source of the voice session, such as wake word detection or push-to-talk.

classes.name: VoiceSessionCoordinator.Session
classes.description: A struct representing a voice recognition session, including session token, source, recognized text, attributed text, state, associated chime, and auto-send delay.

methods.name: startSession
methods.description: Starts a new voice recognition session with the specified source, text, and optional parameters.

methods.name: updatePartial
methods.description: Updates the current session with partial transcription text and optional attributed text.

methods.name: finalize
methods.description: Finalizes the session with provided text, sending chime, and optional auto-send delay.

methods.name: sendNow
methods.description: Immediately sends the current transcript for processing and dismisses the session.

methods.name: dismiss
methods.description: Dismisses the current session with a specified reason and outcome.

methods.name: updateLevel
methods.description: Updates the input level indicator for the current session.

methods.name: snapshot
methods.description: Returns current session token, text, and overlay visibility status.

methods.name: overlayDidDismiss
methods.description: Handles overlay dismissal and resets the session, also refreshes the voice recognition runtime.
